complements: inputs/FULLBODY-MESH-MANIFEST.json (bodyparts3d-fullbody-r1), inputs/MESH-MANIFEST.json (left arm and left shoulder girdle) and packets/face-muscles-r1; no id here repeats one there (the loader refuses a repeated id). Checked also against packets/bodyparts3d-head-r1 (cranium and eye layers, another branch): no shared id.

bodyparts3d-4.0.change: selection only; byte-exact archive members (two acquisition runs, evidence in ACQUISITION-RECORD.json)

z-anatomy-6c7f901.change: documented derivatives: FBX to OBJ, the face packet's recorded similarity into the BodyParts3D frame (the two short foot muscles also one rigid correction per foot), four decimals

rights: Mixed packet, licence per entry (field licence): BodyParts3D 4.0 members are CC BY 4.0 (DBCLS); the zm-* files are CC BY-SA 4.0 derivatives of Z-Anatomy (built on BodyParts3D) and stay share-alike. See ATTRIBUTION-AND-LICENCES.txt and LICENSES/. The game code is CC0 and Three.js MIT; neither changes these asset terms.
not_included: Muscles still not drawn anywhere in the game: multifidus and the rotatores (Z-Anatomy only; its deep upper back sits about 8 to 11 mm behind the BodyParts3D deep back, see ACQUISITION-RECORD.json, so it would cut into the BodyParts3D columns without a regional fit), the interspinales and intertransversarii, the suboccipital muscles, subclavius, the small sole muscles other than flexor digitorum brevis, abductor hallucis and flexor hallucis brevis (quadratus plantae, lumbricals, interossei, adductor hallucis, abductor and flexor digiti minimi of the foot), the pelvic floor, the diaphragm and the intercostals.
source_coordinate_rule: BodyParts3D 4.0 whole-body frame in millimetres (+x subject LEFT, +y POSTERIOR, +z SUPERIOR). FJ files: unchanged archive coordinates. zm- files: the face packet's recorded similarity (scale 9.86027892397196, rotation, translation) applied to the FBX node world coordinates; residuals against the same structures in BodyParts3D are in ACQUISITION-RECORD.json (frame_registration_check).
rig_hint_vocabulary: Display-rig hints [proximal, distal] in ns-body segment names (pelvis, lumbar, thorax, cervical, skull, hyoid, r_/l_girdle, r_/l_upperarm, r_/l_thigh, r_/l_shank, r_/l_foot, r_/l_toes). Not validated soft-tissue insertions or mechanics.

cautions: One reference model for education (BodyParts3D warns of errors and artist-made parts); not a measured person, not a population average, not validated.

The zm- files come from a second atlas placed on this body by one similarity fitted at the head and neck: on the front and sides of the trunk and at the low back they lie within about 2 to 5 mm (median) of the same BodyParts3D structures, on the deep upper back about 8 to 11 mm (ACQUISITION-RECORD.json); they are not re-fitted per muscle, except the two short foot muscles (one rigid correction per foot, fitted to BodyParts3D extensor hallucis brevis and flexor digitorum brevis).
Right-side BodyParts3D files (no M suffix) have header bounds up to 0.48 mm off their own vertices (header_bounds_max_deviation_mm); the mirrored M files match exactly. Kept as found.
Names, what_it_does, rig_hint and bodymap_region are display metadata, not validated anatomy, mechanics or neural mapping.
